This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
func <- function(x,y){ 
  ((2 * pi) ^-1) *((1+x^2 + y^2)^-3/2)}
    xval <- seq(-3,3, by = 1)
    yval <- seq(-3,3, by = 1)
    yeq <- mapply(func, xval, yval)
    matplot(xval, yeq)
#looks norm I guess, but has light tails
comb <- cbind(yval, yeq)
bvnorm.pdf(comb)
print(cov(yval, yeq, method = "spearman"))
    
```

```{r cars}
func <- function(x,y){ 
  ((2 * pi) ^-1) *((1+x^2 + y^2)^-3/2)}
    xval <- seq(-3,3, by = 1)
    yval3 <- rep(c(3),times=7)
    yeq3 <- mapply(func, xval, yval3)
    yval2 <- rep(c(2),times=7)
    yeq2 <- mapply(func, xval, yval2)
    yval1 <- rep(c(1),times=7)
    yeq1 <- mapply(func, xval, yval1)
    yval0 <- rep(c(0),times=7)
    yeq0 <- mapply(func, xval, yval0)
    matplot(xval, yeq0, type = "l")
        matplot(xval, yeq1, type = "l")
            matplot(xval, yeq2, type = "l")
                matplot(xval, yeq3, type = "l")
    
```

## 9
``` {r}
word = c("fun", "sun", "sit", "sat", "fan", "for")
errorSun <- c(1,0,2,2,2,3)
errorThe <- rep(c(3),times=6)
errorFoo <- c(2,3,3,3,2,1)
A <-2 #can change to 50
theta <- 0.1 #can change to 0.95
likelyWord <- ifelse(word == "for", A, 1)
wordChance <- likelyWord / sum(likelyWord)

likeSun <- (theta^errorSun) * (1-theta)^(3-errorSun)
condSun <- likeSun * wordChance/ sum(likeSun * wordChance)
print("Sun intended")
print(condSun)

likeThe <- (theta^errorThe) * (1-theta)^(3-errorThe)
condThe <- likeThe * wordChance/ sum(likeThe * wordChance)
print("The intended")
print(condThe)

likeFoo <- (theta^errorFoo) * (1-theta)^(3-errorFoo)
condFoo <- likeFoo * wordChance/ sum(likeFoo * wordChance)
print("Foo intended")
print(condFoo)
```
